calculate_iou_between_rotated_bboxes: compute intersection over union between two sets of rotated bounding boxes in x, y, w, h, theta format
calculate_iof_between_rotated_bboxes: compute intersection over foreground between two sets of rotated bounding boxes using mode iof
compute_aligned_iou_for_rotated_bboxes: compute aligned pairwise IoU for two equally sized sets of rotated bounding boxes with aligned set to True
compute_iou_with_counter_clockwise_angle: compute IoU for rotated bounding boxes using counter-clockwise angle convention by setting clockwise to False
review_box_iou_rotated_function: review the box_iou_rotated function that calculates IoU or IoF between rotated bounding box tensors
